_about: What to search and where. Keys starting with _ are comments. Each region is swept separately: `python pipeline/ap.py sweep --region <name>`.
_keywords: Breadth is cheap: each keyword costs 1-10 page fetches per location. LinkedIn ignores quotes, so very generic words ("engineer") fill the 100-result cap with noise. Watch the sweep log: a keyword at or below the noise floor returned padding, not matches. Swedish/German/Dutch keywords are worth adding: an ad has to be seen before it can be screened.

regions.name: sweden
regions._country: Must match a key in profile.json work_authorization.by_country to use that entry; otherwise the default entry applies.

regions.name: germany
regions._locations: A large country is better swept city by city: each location gets its own 100-result cap.

regions.name: uk
regions._uk_sponsor_register: Checks each employer against the Home Office register of licensed sponsors (download it first; see pipeline/README.md). Only useful if you need a Skilled Worker visa.

_close_low_priority: When true, a survivor whose provisional priority is Low is closed at ingest, unless it is LinkedIn Easy Apply. Useful where you need sponsorship and most ads say nothing about it.

window._about: Hours to look back. The sweep widens the window by itself to cover the gap since the last successful run of that region, up to max_hours.
